name: windows_fill
description: Clear and fill a text field with new value. Prefers Value pattern for reliability. Without a writable Value pattern it focuses the control and sends Ctrl+A, then Backspace or the new text; it refuses before any key when the control does not take keyboard focus. Reports Filled only when the control reads back the value.

handle.description: Optional window handle to validate against the element ref.

verifyFocus.description: Keyboard fallback only: require verified keyboard focus before Ctrl+A, true for the exact control, "self-or-descendant" for it or any descendant. By default the exact control, or its Edit child when the ref is a ComboBox or Spinner, or a focused Edit inside it with no other value control in between; set false only for a control that never reports focus, and the keys then go wherever focus is.
